nightsiege.book.page1:
§lNight Siege§r

Your base will be attacked. Not by chance, but in planned waves, and harder every time.

This book explains how it works.
nightsiege.book.page2:
§lThe Core§r

The siege core is the heart of your base. Once it stands, the countdown begins.

The first player is given one. A replacement costs a nether star.
nightsiege.book.page3:
§lThe Countdown§r

The clock only runs while at least three players are within 300 blocks of the core.

If you are away, it stops. An abandoned base is never attacked.
nightsiege.book.page4:
§lThe Night§r

The warning comes at sunset, the attack in the dead of night.

A bar appears above with the level and the time left. Hold out until it empties.
nightsiege.book.page5:
§lVictory and Defeat§r

If the time runs out, you have won.

If every defender falls, the blast tears your base open. The core stays, but level and skill tree start over.
nightsiege.book.page6:
§lThe Attackers§r

Only armed mobs dig through walls. A pickaxe opens stone, an axe opens wood.

Chests and bedrock always survive.
nightsiege.book.page7:
§lEvents§r

Some nights are different. A red bar means blood moon: more enemies, tougher and stronger.

On others a glowing champion leads the attack. Cut it down and the wave falters.
nightsiege.book.page8:
§lThe Skill Tree§r

Every night survived earns points for the whole team.

Four branches: melee, ranged, toughness, base.

The bonuses only apply during a siege.

Right click the core to open everything.
